title: Inducible secretion of LIGHT by engineered probiotics enables localized cytokine therapy and robust antitumor immunity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19511-19523
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09644H, Paper

Xinyu Li, Shuaijie Ding, Biao Yang, Yi Wang, Wei Xie
Lactic acid-responsive engineered probiotics selectively colonize TNBC tumors. By secreting LIGHT, they remodel the immunosuppressive microenvironment and inhibit tumor growth, which is a promising targeted treatment approach.
